facts.fact: Aiden 挂电话得知婚礼酒店在五月一日已被订走。
facts.anchor: Hotel’s already booked for May first.

facts.fact: 情人节当天 Jamie 走进花店，被满店红玫瑰与泰迪熊淹没。
facts.anchor: He knew it was Valentine’s Day

facts.fact: Lily-Ann 对花施 changeling 咒，逐句「劝」玫瑰为 Jamie 改变。
facts.anchor: The flowers, obviously. You are beautiful exactly as you are

facts.fact: Jamie 讲出 Amrita 的样子后，玫瑰从花心渗出金色、变成日落色。
facts.anchor: Jamie looked down and realised the roses were slowly changing colour

facts.fact: Amrita 追问花的含义，Jamie 慌乱中只说「就是想给你买花」。
facts.anchor: He panicked. ‘Can they just mean that I wanted to buy you flowers?’

facts.fact: 影院只剩两人，Jamie 把手放在扶手，她迟疑后搭上手指。
facts.anchor: he turned his hand over and lay it on the armrest between them

facts.fact: 回程他想坦白 Hudsbury 的魔法，几次被魔法压住嘴，只能放弃。
facts.anchor: Jamie forced back a sigh of disappointment: he’d tried, but it hadn’t worked.

facts.fact: 车里他缓慢前倾、留出退路，她主动补上最后距离先吻他。
facts.anchor: He leaned forward slowly, giving her plenty of time and space to move back
